title: Building bars
summary: Fill bars exactly in simple and compound time, with triplets and duplets.

provenance.notes: Items drawn from the seeded generators with a teaching-point filter, then fixed. Music and answers come from the rule engine; prompts and feedback are original.

items.prompt: Complete this bar of 3/4. Keep the note given and add notes or rests so the bar adds up exactly. Group them so the beats are clear.
hints: How many beats are still missing?
Group within beats so each beat is visible.
3/4 has three crotchet beats in each bar.

feedback.correct: Perfect bar. Any notes that add up and keep the beats clear are correct.

mistakes.bar-overfull: This bar holds more beats than the time signature allows. Count the beats again and remove the extra.
mistakes.bar-underfull: There's still room in this bar. Count how many beats are missing.
mistakes.grouping-obscures-beat: The beats add up, but it's hard to see where each beat starts. Regroup the notes so every beat is visible.
mistakes.unnecessary-tie: You can write those tied notes as a single note (or a dotted note). That's easier to read.
mistakes.rest-grouping: Each silent beat (or part-beat) normally gets its own rest. Split the silence along the beats.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Check the beat total first, then how the notes are grouped.

items.prompt: Complete this bar of 6/8. Keep the notes given and add notes or rests so the bar adds up exactly. Group them so the beats are clear.
hints: 6/8 has two dotted-crotchet beats in each bar.

feedback.correct: Great. In 6/8 you kept each dotted-crotchet beat clear.

mistakes.bar-overfull: This bar holds more beats than the time signature allows. Count the beats again and remove the extra.
mistakes.bar-underfull: There's still room in this bar. Count how many beats are missing.

mistakes.rest-grouping: Each silent beat (or part-beat) normally gets its own rest. Split the silence along the beats.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Check the beat total first, then how the notes are grouped.

items.prompt: Write one bar of 2/4 that uses a triplet (three notes in the time of two) somewhere in the bar.
hints: Three in the time of two.
A triplet of three quavers fills one crotchet beat.

feedback.correct: Yes! Three quavers in the time of two fill a crotchet beat.

mistakes.tuplet-total-wrong: A tuplet still fills a fixed amount of time. Check which beat it replaces.
mistakes.tuplet-number-wrong: Count the notes that share the beat — that's the number to write over the group.
mistakes.written-value-wrong: Use the note value the group would have if it divided normally — then add the tuplet number.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Ask: how many notes, in the time of how many?

items.prompt: Write one bar of 6/8 that uses a duplet (two notes in the time of three) somewhere in the bar.
hints: Two in the time of three.
A duplet of two quavers fills one dotted-crotchet beat.

feedback.correct: Correct. Two quavers in the time of three fill a dotted-crotchet beat.
